component.name: sfdc_writeback
component.description: FlowBuilder action — drop this onto any event step to POST it to Salesforce. Auth and endpoint are inherited from the parent Salesforce integration.

values.default: javascript@buildtime:(function(){ var lookup = context.getVariableContext().get('integration'); return lookup ? lookup.get('eventsWebhook') : null; })()

settings.name: integration
settings.description: Link to the parent Salesforce integration — provides the webhook ID used to dispatch events.
settings.captured_setting_values_description: Captures the eventsWebhook ID from the linked Salesforce integration.

component.install: javascript@installtime:(function() { var unanchored = Java.from(context.getSourceComponent().getUnanchoredActions()); var controllers = Java.from(context.getTargetComponent().getControllers()); if (unanchored.length > 0 && controllers.length > 0) { var controller = controllers[0]; unanchored.forEach(function(action) { controller.anchorAction(action); }); } })()
